description: This file contains an implementation of the FeatureProperties interface representing a null or placeholder feature property with all methods returning default or empty values. It primarily serves as a null object pattern implementation for FeatureProperties within the project.

classes.name: NullFeatureProperties
classes.description: A null implementation of the FeatureProperties interface that acts as a placeholder returning default values and simulating a JSON null object.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new FeatureProperties object representing a null feature property state.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Returns true indicating this property is treated as an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Returns false indicating this property is not an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true indicating this property represents null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Attempts to return the wrapped value as a boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Attempts to return the wrapped value as an int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Attempts to return the wrapped value as a long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Attempts to return the wrapped value as a double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Attempts to return the wrapped value as a string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the current object instance, representing a JSON object.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Attempts to return the wrapped value as a JSON array.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a given key with various data types, returning a new FeatureProperties instance with that value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value based on a JsonFieldDefinition or JsonField, returning a new FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields, returning a new FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the given key exists, always returns false in this null implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonObject based on a JsonPointer or JsonFieldSelector, always returns self.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the value for a key or a JsonFieldDefinition, always empty in this implementation.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a value or throws an exception if missing; always throws in this class.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an empty list of keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonField for a key, always empty.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator over JsonFields.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the properties are empty, always true.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns zero, indicating no properties.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of JsonFields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts to a JsonObject, always returns the internally stored null object.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes the null value to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns the size estimate for a null literal.
